name: Lumberyard Bistro Interior
description: Inside the Paris café: about 1.3 million triangles, glasses of wine and beer on every table, and 73 textured PBR materials. Shares the Bistro download.
credit: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro by Amazon Lumberyard, from NVIDIA's Open Research Content Archive (ORCA), licensed CC BY 4.0. Lila converts the interior (with wine) to a .lila and makes its glass and drinks see-through.
